standard.summary: 每隔多少步把最近一次 SVD 摘要写进日志和运行时遥测。
standard.effect: 默认 100。如果比检查间隔密，会重复发出最近一次的结果（只发不重算）。设小于 1 启动报错。
standard.whenToUse: 想让日志/前端更密集地看到 SVD 摘要时调小。
standard.avoidWhen: 调太小会产生大量日志行。

standard_en.summary: Steps between emitting the latest SVD summary into the log and runtime telemetry.
standard_en.effect: Default 100. Denser than the check interval re-emits the latest result (emit-only, no recompute). Below 1 fails closed.
standard_en.whenToUse: Lower it to surface SVD summaries more often in logs/UI.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Very small values flood the log.
